admin.active_model_caption: Currently active: **{name}** — used for all new analyses, by every user.
admin.best_f1: 🏆 Best F1: **{model}** (F1 = {f1}). To use it, select it in the model table above and click *Activate selected*.
admin.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
admin.cmp_load_failed: the model could not be loaded
admin.compare_caption: Evaluates each model on up to **{n} labelled image(s)** (re-annotated + external): a detection counts as a hit when it overlaps an annotated bee (IoU ≥ 0.5). Higher **F1** = better balance between finding the bees and not reporting bees that are not there.
admin.compare_need_labels: Comparison requires a labelled set: annotate candidates (*🏷️ Annotation* screen) and/or import an external labelled dataset.
admin.compare_train_overlap: ⚠️ These images may be the same ones used to train the in-app models, so models trained here can look better than they really are. For a fair comparison, check them on new videos.
admin.delete_user_dialog_body: The account **{name}** and **all of its {n} analysis(es)** will be deleted.
admin.eval_confidence_help: Detections with confidence below this value are ignored in the evaluation. Use the same value you use in your analyses.
admin.eval_keep_page_open: ⏳ While the evaluation runs, navigation and the language switch are locked. Do not close the tab or change the sidebar: that interrupts the evaluation.
admin.help_f1: Precision and recall combined into a single number (0 to 1). Higher is better.
admin.help_fn: Annotated bees the model did not detect.
admin.help_fp: Detections where there was no annotated bee.
admin.help_iou: How much the detected boxes overlap the annotated ones, among the hits (0 to 1).
admin.help_last_f1: F1 from the latest comparison run in this session (below).
admin.help_precision: Of the model's detections, how many really were bees.
admin.help_recall: Of the annotated bees, how many the model found.
admin.help_tp: Detections that match an annotated bee.
admin.no_models_found: No model found in `{models_dir}` or `{trained_dir}`. Put the weights there or train one in the *🏷️ Annotation* tab.
admin.select_model_hint: Select a model in the table to activate it.
admin.select_user_hint: Select a user in the table to manage them.

admin.title: Administration
admin.upload_caption: Upload a model trained elsewhere: **.pt** (Ultralytics) or **.weights + .cfg** (Darknet/YOLOv4). It will then appear in the model table and in the comparison. Models are stored in the data volume.
admin.upload_title: 📤 Upload a model trained outside the app
admin.users_caption: {n} user(s) · {n_admins} administrator(s). Deleting a user also removes all of their analyses.
analysis.canvas_unavailable_zones: Drawing component unavailable — monitoring areas cannot be defined in this installation.
analysis.draw_zone_first: Draw at least one area (polygon or circle) before saving.
analysis.end_before_start: The end must be later than the start.
analysis.first_frame_unreadable_zones: Could not read the first frame to define areas.
analysis.help_adjust: **Adjust** mode: click a shape to select it, drag to move or resize it, and use the **trash** icon (canvas toolbar) to delete it. Useful for correcting automatically detected dishes.
analysis.help_circle: Draw **one circle per area**: click and drag to set its size. Then click *Save areas*.
analysis.help_polygon: Draw **one polygon per area**: click each vertex and **click the first point again** to close it. Then click *Save areas*.
analysis.help_toolbar_edit: **To fix an area:** hover over the image — a toolbar appears in the top-right corner; click the **pencil (Edit)**. While it is on, click a shape to select it: drag to move it, pull the small squares to resize or stretch it (it becomes an ellipse) and the top handle to rotate it; the **✕** deletes the selected shape. Switch the pencil off to draw again and, when done, click *Save areas*.
analysis.hough_caption: Finds the Petri dishes in the first frame and creates a monitoring area for each one. Then check them in the drawing below and correct them if needed.
analysis.hough_found: {n} dish(es) detected and saved as monitoring areas. Check them in the drawing; if you correct anything, click **{save}**.
analysis.hough_n: How many dishes are in the video?
analysis.hough_n_help: The N sharpest circular outlines in the first frame are marked.
analysis.hough_none: No dishes found. Under *{fine}*, lower **{rigor}** or adjust the minimum/maximum dish size.
analysis.hough_sensitivity_help: Lower = finds more circles (including false ones); higher = only the sharpest outlines.
analysis.hough_size_help: Dish radius as a percentage of the shorter side of the video.
analysis.keep_page_open: ⏳ While processing runs, navigation and the language switch are locked. Do not close the tab or change the sidebar: that **interrupts processing** and nothing is saved.
analysis.no_bees_tips: Tips: in **{settings} → {section}**, lower **{conf_label}** (currently {conf}) or reduce **{skip_label}** (currently {skip}) to analyse more frames. Also check that the bees lie inside the areas defined in *{zones_tool}* — detections outside them are discarded.
analysis.no_frames: Could not read any frame from the video.
analysis.no_zones_global: No areas defined — the report will contain global data only.
analysis.onb_prepare: Optional: calibrate the scale (px → mm) and define the dishes.
analysis.onb_process: Detects and tracks the bees; metrics and reports are saved.
analysis.onb_tips: 📹 **Recording tips:** fixed camera (tripod), whole dish visible in the frame, even lighting without glare. Maximum file size: {max}. Previous analyses are in **{history}**.
analysis.onb_trim: Pick a start and end to skip handling at the beginning and end.
analysis.onb_upload: Upload the dish video (.mp4, .avi or .mov) in the field below.
analysis.phase_reading: 📂 Reading the segment: {total} frames, 1 in every {skip} will be analysed (≈{n}).
analysis.process_disabled_help: Adjust the segment: the end must be after the start.
analysis.processing: Processing video (1 in every {skip} frames, {n} dish(es))…
analysis.review_caption: Video assembled from the processed frames with the detections drawn — useful to check key moments and tune the parameters (confidence, NMS, areas, zoom).
analysis.review_empty_note: Only the video from the latest run is kept, and only during this session (it is lost when you sign out or reload the page).
analysis.review_empty_steps:
1. In **{settings} → {section}**, keep **{option}** ticked.
2. Process a video on the **{new}** screen.
3. Come back here to watch the video with the detections drawn.
analysis.review_empty_title: #### No review video in this session
analysis.review_unreadable: Could not read the review video file.
analysis.segment_help: Set the start and end. Only this segment of the video will be processed — useful to skip handling at the beginning/end.
analysis.settings_hint: These settings are adjusted in the sidebar, under **{settings}**.
analysis.tool_help: Draw on the first frame of the video: a line of known length (scale) or the outline of each dish (monitoring areas). Both are optional; one tool at a time.
analysis.video_kept: 🎞️ Current video: **{name}** (uploaded earlier). Upload another file above to replace it.
analysis.zones_as_dishes: {n} area(s) defined: each area will be treated as one dish. Detections outside the areas are discarded.
analysis.zones_defined_rename: **{n} area(s) defined.** Rename them below if you wish:
analysis.zones_unsaved: The drawing has changes that are not saved yet — click *{save}* to apply them to the areas.
annot.all_done: No pending candidates — everything is annotated! 🎉
annot.auto_advance_hint: After validating, saving, marking or discarding, the next pending candidate opens automatically.
annot.base_model_help: Starting point for training. Pretrained ones (suffix **n** = light and fast; **s** = larger and slightly more accurate) are downloaded from the internet on first use. Pick a model already trained in the app (or the active one) to continue training from it.
annot.clear_external_dialog_body: **{n_img} image(s)** and **{n_lbl} label file(s)** imported into the server will be removed. Candidates re-annotated in the app are not affected.
annot.dataset_breakdown: Breakdown: ✅ {validated} validated · ✍️ {reannotated} re-annotated · 🚫 {negatives} negative(s) — {review} from 🎬 Review.
annot.discard_help: Removes the candidate from the dataset (poor, cropped or ambiguous image). It is not used for training.
annot.download_zip_caption: File: `{name}` — re-annotated candidates only (the external dataset is not included).
annot.draw_instructions: Draw **one rectangle per bee** (click and drag). Select a box to move/resize it; use the trash icon in the canvas toolbar to delete it. If the suggested boxes are right, use *Validate prediction*; if they need fixing, edit them and use *Save annotation*. If there is no bee, use *No bee*.
annot.epochs_help: Epochs = how many times the model goes through all the images. More epochs = longer training; with few images, too many epochs make the model memorise the set.
annot.export_caption: {n_img} image(s) · {n_box} box(es) · {n_neg} negative(s) (no bee). Only candidates with status *annotated* or *no bee* are included.
annot.export_empty: There are no annotated candidates to export yet.
annot.export_outdated: The annotations have changed since the .zip was built. Build it again to download the current version.
annot.flash_no_bee: Candidate #{id} marked as containing no bee.
annot.imgsz_help: Size the images are resized to during training. Larger helps with small bees but is slower and uses more memory.
annot.import_bad_zip: The uploaded file is not a valid .zip. Compress the folder with the images and .txt files and upload it again.
annot.import_caption: Current external dataset: **{n_img} image(s)**, {n_lbl} label file(s). Import here the original images used for YOLOv4 (YOLO format: images + .txt). They are used for training together with the re-annotated ones.
annot.import_no_images: No images (.jpg, .png, .bmp) were found in the .zip ({n_lbl} label file(s)). Check that the images are inside the archive.
annot.import_report: Imported **{n} image(s)**: {with_lbl} with labels and {without} without labels.
annot.import_report_negatives: The {n} image(s) without labels are used for training as images with **no bee**. If they do contain bees, upload the matching .txt files too.
annot.import_report_orphans: {n} label file(s) have no image with the same name and will not be used.
annot.need_more_images: Gather at least ~5 images (re-annotated and/or imported; ideally dozens) for a minimally viable training run.
annot.no_boxes: No boxes drawn. Use *No bee* if that is the case.
annot.no_candidates: No candidates collected yet. On the **🎬 Review** screen, collect the frames that had no detection — or enable **'🏷️ Collect candidates for re-annotation'** in the sidebar and process a video, or import labelled images under **📦 Data** and train directly.
annot.no_canvas: Drawing component is unavailable in this installation.
annot.no_ultralytics: Ultralytics is not installed in this image. Rebuild the image (`ultralytics` was added to requirements) to enable in-app training.
annot.profile_accurate_desc: Larger model, 200 epochs, 640 px images — slower; worthwhile with many annotated images and a GPU.
annot.profile_balanced_desc: Light model, 100 epochs, 640 px images — a good balance between time and quality.
annot.profile_fast_desc: Light model, 30 epochs, 416 px images — good for checking whether training improves detection.
annot.profile_help: Sets the base model, number of epochs and resolution in one go. Fine-tune them under *Advanced*.
annot.progress_line: 📥 **{collected}** collected ({pending} pending, {discarded} discarded) → ✍️ **{annotated}** annotated → 🧠 **{trained}** trained model(s)

annot.train_caption: Trains a YOLO model (Ultralytics) on **{n_reannot} image(s) labelled in the app** + **{n_ext} external image(s)** = {total} image(s). The resulting model is saved and can be compared and activated under **⚙️ Administration → 🧠 Models**.
annot.train_err_no_images: No usable annotated images were found. Annotate some candidates under **✍️ Re-annotate** or import labelled images under **📦 Data** and try again.
annot.train_err_offline: The base model **{base}** could not be downloaded: this server seems to have no internet access. Connect the server to the internet and try again, or ask the administrator to place the file `{base}` in the app folder.
annot.train_err_oom: The system ran out of memory during training. Choose the **Fast** profile or lower the image resolution under *Advanced* and try again.
annot.train_err_other: Training failed. The technical details are below; if the problem persists, send them to the administrator.
annot.train_keep_page_open: Keep this page open while training: switching screens, changing the sidebar or closing the tab **interrupts training**.
annot.train_no_file: Training finished but the model file was not found. Check the logs.
annot.train_ok_admin: ✅ Training complete! Model saved as **{name}**. Activate it now or compare it with the others under **⚙️ Administration → 🧠 Models**.
annot.train_ok_user: ✅ Training complete! Model saved as **{name}**. Ask an administrator to compare and activate it under **⚙️ Administration → 🧠 Models**.
annot.train_on_cpu: 🐢 No GPU available: training will run on the **CPU**, which is much slower (tens of minutes to hours). Start with the **Fast** profile.
annot.train_summary: Will train: base model **{base}** · **{epochs}** epochs · **{imgsz} px** images.

annot.validate_disabled_help: There is no suggested box to validate. Draw the boxes and save, or mark *No bee*.
annot.validate_edited_help: The canvas does not show exactly the suggested boxes (you edited them or the item already has labels). To store what is on the canvas, use *Save annotation*.
annot.validate_help: The below-threshold prediction is right: saves exactly the suggested boxes (ignoring canvas edits).
annot.validate_note: *Validate prediction* stores the suggested boxes exactly as the network produced them; if you edit any, use *Save annotation*.

dataset.readme:
YOLO dataset generated by BeeMove.
Images: {n_imgs} | Boxes: {n_boxes} | Negatives (no bee): {n_neg}

Training (example, Ultralytics):
  yolo detect train data=data.yaml model=yolov8n.pt epochs=100 imgsz=640

history.login_about:
- 🎥 **Tracks bees** in videos of Petri dishes, one bee per dish or monitoring area.
- 📊 **Computes walking metrics** (distance, speed, time stopped, time spent per area) and builds Excel/PDF reports.
- 🏷️ **Improves the model** through assisted annotation of uncertain frames and fine-tuning.

history.no_bees_detected: No bees detected in the processed frames with the current parameters.
history.select_hint: No row selected — showing the most recent analysis.

results.calibrated_scale: Calibrated scale: **{ppm:.2f} px/mm** — metrics in millimetres.
results.explored_area_needs_3: The explored area needs at least 3 detections.
results.no_background: Spatial charts cannot be drawn without the background frame.
results.no_data_chart: Not enough data for this chart.
results.no_zones: No monitoring area defined for this analysis.
results.stop_threshold_in_use: ⏸️ Stop threshold in use: **{px} px** between samples{equiv} — affects time moving/stopped. To change it: {where} → *{label}*.
results.straightness_help: Net displacement ÷ path length. 1 = straight line; close to 0 = highly tortuous path.
results.time_moving_help: Fraction of time with displacement ≥ {thr:.0f} px between samples.
results.time_not_detected_help: Processed frames in which the bee was not detected.
results.trajectory_needs_2: The trajectory needs at least 2 detections.
results.zones_caption: Dwell time = time (s) the bee spent inside the area (samples inside × sampling interval). % of detections = share of the detections that fell inside the area. Visits = number of entries into the area.
review.all_collected: Every frame/area without a detection in this analysis has already been collected. Annotate them below.
review.already_collected: {n} already collected from this analysis; {left} left to collect.
review.annot_caption: Analysis #{id}. Frames where the model accepted no detection (it stayed below the confidence threshold) become images for you to **validate** the weak prediction or **re-annotate**. They go to **🏷️ Annotation → 📦 Data** and are used in the next training run.
review.collect_hint: Will collect up to **{n}** item(s), spread over the analysed segment. Navigation is locked until it finishes.
review.counts: From this analysis: **{pending}** pending · ✅ **{validated}** validated · ✍️ **{reannotated}** re-annotated · 🚫 **{no_bee}** no bee · 🗑️ **{discarded}** discarded
review.max_items_help: Maximum number of images (whole frames or area crops) to collect now. They are picked at even intervals among the frames without detection.
review.mode_whole: No areas defined: each item is the **whole frame**.
review.mode_zones: With {n} area(s) defined: each item is the **crop of one area** (smaller image, bigger bee), only for the area that had no detection.
review.needs_model: A loaded detection model is needed to collect the frames.
review.no_video_but_ctx: No review video was generated for this run (option **{option}** was off), but you can still annotate the frames without detection below.
review.none_missing: Every processed frame had an accepted detection at threshold {conf:.2f} — nothing to collect.
review.stats_whole: Of the **{total}** processed frames, **{frames}** had fewer bees detected than expected ({n}) at confidence threshold **{conf:.2f}**.
review.stats_zones: Of the **{total}** processed frames, **{frames}** had no accepted detection in at least one area at confidence threshold **{conf:.2f}** — **{pairs}** area crop(s) in total.
review.suggest_conf_help: Suggested boxes come from an extra pass at this confidence, well below the analysis threshold ({conf:.2f}). Lower = more suggestions (and more false positives).
review.unreadable: {n} frame(s)/area(s) could not be read from the video and were left out of the collection.
review.video_gone: The original video of this analysis is no longer available in this session (it was removed or replaced). Upload and process it again to collect more frames; the ones already collected remain below.
sidebar.collect_candidates_help: During processing, samples frames whose best detection is weak (below the re-annotation threshold) or missing and stores them for re-annotation in the '🏷️ Annotation' tab — the basis of the fine-tuning dataset.
sidebar.crop_detection_help: When areas are defined: crops each area (with a side margin, as in the per-area result crop) and feeds ONLY the crop to the network — the bee covers many more pixels, improving detection in low-resolution videos. Only the delimited areas are considered; if the bee from an adjacent dish appears in the margin, it is discarded as a false positive (its centre must lie inside this area and outside the neighbouring ones). Has no effect without defined areas. Slower (one detection per area per frame) and requires reprocessing the video.
sidebar.cuda_arch_mismatch: The image was built for a different GPU architecture. Rebuild with `--build-arg CUDA_ARCH_BIN="<your GPU's compute capability>"` (see `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap --format=csv`).
sidebar.fp16_help: ~2x faster on GPUs with Tensor Cores; virtually identical accuracy.
sidebar.gpu_failed_plain: A GPU was found but did not work with this model; processing is running on the CPU (slower). See the technical details.
sidebar.gpu_off: GPU switched off: processing runs on the CPU (slower).
sidebar.gpu_ready: ⚡ GPU in use: processing runs on the graphics card.
sidebar.input_size_help: 320 is faster; 512 detects small objects better.
sidebar.no_gpu_plain: No GPU: processing runs on the CPU (slower). Increase '{skip_label}' to speed it up.
sidebar.num_dishes_help: Keeps the N highest-confidence detections in each frame and tracks each one as a separate dish/bee. Use when there are several dishes in the same video. Requires reprocessing the video.
sidebar.review_threshold_help: Only used when collecting re-annotation candidates: frames whose best detection falls BELOW this value (or with no detection) become candidates. It does not change the 🎬 Review video.
sidebar.review_video_help: Creates an MP4 with detections drawn on the processed frames (🟧 areas · 🟨 raw YOLO detections with confidence · 🟩 accepted/tracked detection), shown in the '🎬 Review' tab. Helps tune the parameters. Slightly increases processing time.
sidebar.stop_threshold_help: Displacements smaller than this count as a 'stop' in the time-in-motion metrics. Adjust to the video scale. No reprocessing needed — recomputed instantly.
sidebar.tech_check_opencv: GPU check: OpenCV with CUDA (Darknet `.weights` models) → {result}
sidebar.tech_no_cuda_hint: To use a GPU with Darknet models, run the GPU Docker image (OpenCV built with CUDA) with `--gpus all`.
sidebar.use_gpu_help: Uses the graphics card (NVIDIA GPU) to detect bees faster. Available only when the server has a GPU usable by the active model.
sidebar.zones_defined_info: 🎯 **{n} area(s) defined**: each area is one dish, so the number of dishes comes from the areas. Clear the areas (*New analysis* tab) to set the number manually.
